text:
nina: Seeing streaming glitches after client reconnects: chunks reorder and sometimes `event: done` never arrives. Repro simple: start stream, kill client, reconnect.
sam: Can you paste raw chunk capture? which SDK?
nina: Using inference-js v1.2.0 and a lightweight mobile lib. Raw (simplified):
```
data: {"seq":1,"t":"A"}

data: {"seq":2,"t":"B"}

<disconnect>
/data: {"seq":2,"t":"B"}
data: {"seq":3,"t":"C"}
/event: done
```
Note the stray leading `/` and dup seq=2 after reconnect.
alexa: Sounds like partial-write + proxy coalescing. JS parser used to split on `\n\n` which breaks if chunk boundaries occur inside JSON.
sam: Fix plan: parser state machine that buffers until blank line and treats lines starting with `data:` as event starts; also add seq-based dedupe and small reorder window (200ms).
ops-bot: stream-health(us-east-1): brief spike in stream errors 5m ago.
ci-bot: CI: sse-repro test flaky on packet-split cases. See run/9812.
nina: Mobile clients also time out at ~60s; adding server `:ping` every 25s and increasing client read timeout helped in staging.
alexa: Also add SSE `id:` header per event (monotonic) and support Last-Event-ID on reconnect for resume. Ticket INF-1177.
sam: Will add SDK logs to surface missing `seq` and a flag `sse_legacy_mode` to retain old behavior for one release.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: streaming-robustness -> staging https://deploys/internal/streaming-robustness
nina: Integration test suggestion: simulate mid-TCP close, reconnect, assert assembled payload equals golden.
sam: Filed SDK-721 (state machine) + INF-1177 (server id/ping). Will link PRs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
